seo.description: Everything a journalist or partner needs: the logo in its forms, the approved description at three lengths, the founder's bio, and cryptographically signed numbers.

h: A press kit ready to copy
lede: Writing about us? Take what you need straight from here. The description is approved, and the numbers are signed — you can verify them yourself before you publish.

boilerplate.h: Three lengths — copy whichever fits your space

items.label: One line
items.text: Awalim Group: a Palestinian digital engineering house building the enterprise systems that run companies.

items.label: Short paragraph
items.text: Awalim Group is a digital engineering house founded in 2021 in Palestine, building enterprise products to a global standard: a double-entry accounting system on IFRS, AI agents that work inside client systems, Flutter apps and web platforms. It serves clients in more than ten countries and runs an engineering academy that has trained hundreds of engineers.

items.label: Full paragraph
items.text: Awalim Group is a digital engineering house founded in 2021 in Palestine by Ahmed Ashraf, who began in 2018 from Gaza with a mobile phone and a slow connection. The group today builds enterprise products that hold under real pressure: Smart Accountant — a complete double-entry accounting system built on IFRS and Arabic from the root; AI agents that carry out tasks inside client systems with written permission boundaries and a human in the approval loop; and Flutter apps and web platforms measured against a strict performance budget. Awalim serves clients in more than ten countries and runs an engineering academy taught the way it works: a real project, code review and tests. The group publishes its public numbers cryptographically signed so any visitor can verify them in their own browser.

assets.note: Use the logo on a background that gives clear contrast, and do not recolour it, distort its proportions, or place it inside another shape.

founder.bio: Ahmed Ashraf is the founder and chief engineer of Awalim Group. He began programming in 2018 from Gaza with a mobile phone and a slow connection, and turned solo work into an engineering house in 2021. He leads the development of Smart Accountant and the group's product ecosystem, and oversees the Awalim engineering academy.

facts.h: Numbers you can verify before you publish
facts.note: Every number here is signed with an Ed25519 key when the site is built. The verification page runs the check in your own browser.
